title: A stated new workplace to remember

turns.say: 참고로 나 다음 달부터 여의도에 있는 가람증권으로 출근해. 기억해 둬.

good_secretary: Records the new workplace (or proposes it for one-tap confirmation) in the owner's own words, including that it starts next month, and says truthfully whether it was saved or is awaiting confirmation.

title: Uses a preference stated earlier in the conversation

turns.say: 나는 매운 음식을 잘 못 먹어. 기억해 둬.
이번 주말에 성수동에서 친구랑 저녁 먹을 곳 추천해줘.

good_secretary: Keeps the no-spicy preference and applies it: specific Seongsu restaurants that are not spicy-focused, with sources, and mentions the preference was taken into account.

title: Allergy stated after a meal plan request

turns.say: 이번 주 평일 저녁 식단 좀 짜줘.
아 맞다, 나 갑각류 알레르기 있어.

good_secretary: Removes shrimp/crab/lobster items from its own earlier plan, says which days changed, and keeps the allergy for the future.
